items.name: Medkit
items.description: Restore 65 health. Choose MEDKIT to use one. Medkits have their own inventory space and a wait time between uses.

items.name: Reclaimed wire
items.description: Material for making level 0 equipment and supplies at Patch’s shop. Collected from patrol enemies or by breaking down equipment.

items.name: Ceramic lattice
items.description: Material for making level 10 equipment and supplies at Patch’s shop. Reusing these circuits saves mining new ones.

items.name: Glassroot optic
items.description: Material for making level 20 equipment and supplies at Patch’s shop. These lenses were once used to survey occupied homes.

items.name: Phase cell
items.description: Material for making level 35 equipment and supplies at Patch’s shop. Lift crews also use these batteries to keep rescue routes working.

items.name: Afterlight alloy
items.description: Material for making level 50 equipment and supplies at Patch’s shop. Patch removes the locks that let companies control this metal.

items.name: Street coil
items.description: A replaceable carbine module. Stacks with Patch's permanent weapon upgrades. The first Commons crews shared this design when the licensed replacements stopped arriving.

items.name: Shelter vest
items.description: Layered cloth and reclaimed plating. The lining leaves a space for your chosen name and return instructions.

items.name: Surveyor lens
items.description: A civilian targeting lens with its collection orders removed. Its reticle still carries the tiny box once used to mark an occupied home as vacant.

items.name: District coil
items.description: Ceramic conductors stabilize an upgraded carbine module. The replacement schedule is printed on the casing, where the next repairer can find it.

items.name: Ceramic vest
items.description: Replaceable plates protect the wearer and reinforce shields. Each plate can be replaced without discarding the sound pieces around it.

items.name: District lens
items.description: A targeting implant with a small ceramic reserve. A scratched note reads: check what the counter leaves out.

items.name: Basin coil
items.description: Glassroot conductors focus each discharge. The carrier’s mark belongs to a supply crew, not the company that once owned the road.

items.name: Rootweave vest
items.description: Flexible basin fibers support a ceramic shield frame. Its repair label records the water used to prepare the fibers.

items.name: Basin lens
items.description: Precision optics backed by distributed reserves. The calibration margin has room for a second observer’s correction.

items.name: Phase coil
items.description: A skyline induction module with carefully timed pulses. Recovered from enforcement stock and rebuilt to a public maintenance sheet.

items.name: Skyline vest
items.description: Freight-crew protection built for exposed skyways. Its pockets were sized for a night worker’s meal tin and relief notes.

items.name: Phase lens
items.description: A phase-stabilized probability lens. The original counted payable journeys; the rewritten controller tracks motion alone.

items.name: Afterlight coil
items.description: Self-repairing conductors retain a perfect discharge pattern. The fabrication instructions include the failures that taught the crew how to repair it.

items.name: Afterlight vest
items.description: Memory alloy redistributes pressure across its whole surface. Its open repair pattern was copied from a workshop that could no longer afford replacements.

items.name: Tomorrow's witness
items.description: An original surveyor archive rebuilt to protect tomorrow's residents. The archive’s final instruction is to leave room for a witness the survey did not expect.

items.name: Commons broth
items.description: Gives the bonuses listed below for 5 minutes while alive and playing. Pauses while dead or offline. Replaces your current food or drink bonus. You can use one food or drink bonus and one tool coating bonus together.

classes.description: Three Sustainer points grant +10 healing and +1 energy regeneration per second.

classes.name: Closed circuit
classes.description: Spend three points in Artificer to make abilities use 3% less energy and take 3% less time to become ready again.

classes.name: Open ledger
classes.description: Three Prospector points grant 5% more gold from patrol enemies and 2 percentage points of armor penetration.
